title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models

problem.summary: In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5× larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction.
statements: In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5× larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction.

Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection.
We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.
